# نُخْتَبَزُ (nuḵtabazu) /nux.ta.ba.zu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَبَزَ (iḵtabaza)
# نَخْتَبِزَ (naḵtabiza) /nax.ta.bi.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَبَزَ (iḵtabaza)
# نُخْتَبَزَ (nuḵtabaza) /nux.ta.ba.za/:
